summary: Porting uhitm.c:mhitm_ad_halu and wiring its existing dispatcher arm removed the step-179 stop. The replay then exposed an unbound source-ordered mondead call in the existing mhitm.c:explmm path; importing the already ported mon.c:mondead restored the caller. evidence: The admitted v50 manifest gives source trace mhitm.c:explmm -> mdamagem -> uhitm.c:mhitm_ad_halu; its baseline has 179/218 screens, 2727/2782 RNG calls, and 179/218 cursors matched.
The recorded step 179 has key '.', with the C screen reporting the black light explosion; its RNG ends at d(10,12)=66 @ mdamagem(mhitm.c:1025), immediately before the unsupported AD_HALU handler.

C source uhitm.c:mhitm_ad_halu() has three actor cases: hero aggressor and hero defender both set damage to zero; monster-versus-monster confusion requires an uncancelled aggressor, eyed defender, and defender able to see. A visible defender receives the source message before mconf is set; all monster-pair cases clear STRAT_WAITFORU and set damage to zero.

The source grep finds one active C call site, the AD_HALU arm in uhitm.c:mhitm_adtyping(). js/uhitm.js already dispatches that arm to an unported boundary. This task will port only mhitm_ad_halu and wire that existing arm; it will not claim the whole dispatcher or mhitm.c callers.
C callees haseyes(), canseemon(), and Monnam()/pline_mon() have existing JavaScript implementations; no return-valued unported dependency was found.
